labels.arrival: MEASURED: the 2025 forecast P(any new staking in the section) from scripts/claims_forecast.py (held-out skill in claim-activity-forecast.md). labels.bids: ASSUMED two-point offers for the full block, as in the Tok demo. For scale: the clean NV/AZ catalogue median is about $285/acre, roughly $177k for White Rock's estimated 620 acres.
labels.acceleration: ASSUMPTION: remaining stages may be paid early to complete a sale. Not stated in the White Rock release.
labels.wait: ASSUMPTION: if we wait 12 months and watch nearby staking, the same terms are still available with probability 0.5. The engine reports the probability at which waiting beats buying now.
